Frequently Asked Questions

Got questions? We’ve got answers. Here are some common queries we receive about washing machine service in Vadodara.

How much does it cost to repair a washing machine motor in India?

The cost to repair a washing machine motor in India, including Vadodara, typically ranges from ₹1,500 to ₹5,000 or more. The final price depends on the machine’s brand (e.g., Bosch vs. a local brand), model, and whether the motor needs a simple repair or a full replacement. At Atlas Aircon, we provide a precise and affordable washing machine repair vadodara quote after a technician inspects the unit.

Why is my washing machine stopping mid-cycle?

There are several reasons your washing machine might be stopping mid-cycle: a faulty lid switch, an issue with the water inlet valve, a clogged drain filter preventing the machine from draining, an unbalanced load, or a malfunctioning PCB (control board). Our technicians are experts at diagnosing the root cause to provide a quick and effective fix.

Is it better to repair or replace a washing machine?

This depends on the age of your machine and the cost of the repair. As a rule of thumb, if the repair cost is less than 50% of the price of a new machine and your current appliance is less than 8-10 years old, repairing is usually the more economical choice. Our washing machine technician in Vadodara will give you an honest assessment to help you decide.

What is a washing machine AMC and do you provide it?

An AMC is an Annual Maintenance Contract. It’s a great way to ensure your appliance runs smoothly and prevent costly breakdowns. Yes, we offer a comprehensive washing machine amc in vadodara, which includes periodic servicing and priority support.
